source_notice: Actual official final PDF copyright Michal Garlik, licensed under CC-BY4.0. All collected proofs occur in the published main text/AppendicesA-I, including final proofs of Theorems1/2 and more-general24.
transcription_method: Author arXiv2003.10230v1 native TeX was used solely as an editable transcription aid for the content actually published in the official CC BY4.0 version. Its raw nonexclusive-distribution archive is local-only and is not a public original. Public-source.tex omits original frontmatter, comments and unselected future-work text with blank lines preserving source locators. Native proof-ordering differs from official appendices but mathematical statements and complete proof arguments correspond. Four rule-display trees were mechanically replaced by the same formulas in an amsmath fraction table. No author mathematical argument is supplied.
